name: Nirvana

whyMatters.en: Aberdeen/Seattle grunge band formed in 1987. Nevermind (1991) put quiet-loud dynamics and Cobain’s songwriting on MTV and US rock radio; In Utero (1993) followed on DGC.
whyMatters.zh: 阿伯丁/西雅图 grunge 乐队，1987 年成立。《Nevermind》（1991）把强弱动态与 Cobain 的写歌带到 MTV 与美国摇滚电台；《In Utero》（1993）同在 DGC 发行。

note.en: From Nevermind; quiet verse / loud chorus; heavy MTV and rock-radio play in 1991.
note.zh: 出自《Nevermind》；轻主歌/响副歌；1991 年 MTV 与摇滚电台高曝光。

note.en: Nevermind single; delay on the main riff; wide rock-radio play.
note.zh: 《Nevermind》单曲；主 riff 带延时；摇滚电台广泛播放。

note.en: From In Utero; restrained band track under Cobain’s vocal.
note.zh: 出自《In Utero》；乐队编配克制，Cobain 人声靠前。

interviewQuotes.text: I'd rather be hated for who I am, than loved for who I am not.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Kurt Cobain
interviewQuotes.source: Widely circulated interview excerpt · quote wall

interviewQuotes.text: We don't want to be the next Beatles. We just want to be Nirvana.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Krist Novoselic

lyricQuotes: All in all is all we are

shortBio.en: Cobain / Novoselic / Grohl grunge, 1987–94. Smells Like Teen Spirit and Nevermind are the main 1991 reference points.
shortBio.zh: Cobain / Novoselic / Grohl 的 grunge，1987–94。《Smells Like Teen Spirit》与《Nevermind》是 1991 年的主要参照。

body.en:
Nirvana formed in Aberdeen, Washington, in 1987. Bleach (1989, Sub Pop) was recorded with Chad Channing on drums. Dave Grohl joined in 1990. Nevermind (1991, DGC; produced with Butch Vig) reached Billboard 200 #1. In Utero (1993; Steve Albini) followed on the same label.

The core writing is quiet verse / loud chorus, Cobain’s melody under fuzz, Novoselic’s wide bass lines, and Grohl’s hard kick. Later 1990s rock radio and many bands reused the dynamic shape.

Cobain and Novoselic started the band in 1987. Drums before Grohl ran through Aaron Burckhard, Dave Foster, Dale Crover (three songs), and Chad Channing. Bleach (1989) came out on Sub Pop. Jason Everman is the extra guitar credit; he later played bass in Soundgarden. Dan Peters (Mudhoney) sits on the timeline just before Grohl. Nevermind (1991) on DGC, with Grohl: the book says US sales ran about 400,000 a week by year-end and took the #1 slot from Michael Jackson’s Dangerous. A Cobain line, Chinese-edition wording: the first time he heard Pixies, he felt he belonged in that band, or in one copying them.

In Utero (1993) also hit US #1. Pat Smear played the last tours. Lori Goldston played cello on the 1993 MTV Unplugged, released in 1994. Cobain died on 5 April 1994.
body.zh:
Nirvana 于 1987 年在华盛顿州阿伯丁成立。《Bleach》（1989，Sub Pop）录制时鼓手为 Chad Channing。Dave Grohl 于 1990 年加入。《Nevermind》（1991，DGC；Butch Vig 参与制作）登上 Billboard 200 冠军。《In Utero》（1993；Steve Albini）同在该厂牌发行。

写法以轻主歌/响副歌为主：Cobain 的旋律压在 fuzz 下，Novoselic 贝斯线较宽，Grohl 底鼓偏硬。后来 1990 年代摇滚电台与许多乐队沿用了这套动态。

Cobain 与 Novoselic 1987 年组建乐队。Grohl 之前的鼓手依次是 Aaron Burckhard、Dave Foster、Dale Crover（三首歌）与 Chad Channing。《Bleach》（1989）由 Sub Pop 发行。Jason Everman 是额外的吉他署名，后来在 Soundgarden 弹贝斯。Dan Peters（Mudhoney）排在 Grohl 之前。《Nevermind》（1991）在 DGC，鼓手是 Grohl：书中写到年底美国每周约卖 40 万张，并把 Michael Jackson《Dangerous》挤下榜首。中文版所引 Cobain：他第一次听到 Pixies 时，觉得自己该在那支乐队里，或至少在一支模仿他们的乐队里。

《In Utero》（1993）同样登上美国榜首。Pat Smear 参加最后几轮巡演。Lori Goldston 在 1993 年 MTV Unplugged 拉大提琴，唱片 1994 年发行。Cobain 1994 年 4 月 5 日去世。

body.en:
After Smells Like Teen Spirit, Nevermind moved from college and alternative playlists onto mainstream MTV and rock radio.

The records pair punk roughness with hard-rock weight. Press and videos from the period often show the band rejecting standard rock-star presentation.
body.zh:
《Smells Like Teen Spirit》之后，《Nevermind》从学院与 alternative 播放列表进入主流 MTV 与摇滚电台。

唱片把朋克的粗糙感与 hard-rock 重量放在一起。同期访谈与录像里，乐队常公开拒绝常规摇滚明星形象。

title.en: Bleach lineup and the Grohl trio
title.zh: Bleach 阵容与 Grohl 三人组

body.en:
Bleach documents the Sub Pop years with Chad Channing on drums. Cobain, Novoselic, and Grohl are the lineup most cited for Nevermind and In Utero.

Earlier drummers matter to the early catalog; MTV-scale memory centers on Grohl’s kit from 1990–94.

The pre-Grohl drum chair changes four times. Everman moves on to Soundgarden’s bass. Goldston plays cello on the Unplugged session.
body.zh:
《Bleach》记录 Sub Pop 时期，鼓手为 Chad Channing。Cobain、Novoselic 与 Grohl 是《Nevermind》《In Utero》最常被引用的编制。

更早的鼓手属于早期目录；MTV 尺度的记忆集中在 1990–94 年 Grohl 的鼓组。

Grohl 之前鼓的位子换了四次。Everman 后来去 Soundgarden 弹贝斯。Goldston 在 Unplugged 拉大提琴。

alt.en: Kurt Cobain and Krist Novoselic of Nirvana, MTV Video Music Awards, 1992
alt.zh: Kurt Cobain 与 Krist Novoselic，Nirvana，1992 年 MTV 音乐录影带大奖

body.en:
Quiet-loud verse/chorus writing was already familiar from acts such as the Pixies. MTV and rock radio amplified this track until it became a fixed 1991 reference.

The video’s cheerleader satire is part of the media event. The musical pivot is the drop into distortion on the chorus.
body.zh:
主歌轻、副歌响的写法在 Pixies 等乐队里已有先例。MTV 与摇滚电台放大了这首单曲，使其成为 1991 年的固定参照。

录像里的啦啦队讽刺是媒介事件的一部分。音乐上的转折是副歌切入失真。

body.en:
Cobain’s melodies sit under fuzz and power chords. Novoselic’s bass is melodic and wide in the mix. Grohl’s kick often marks section changes like a hard cut.

Later bands frequently copy the quiet-loud outline. Public refusal of rock-star presentation is harder to copy as a method.
body.zh:
Cobain 的旋律压在 fuzz 与 power chord 下。Novoselic 的贝斯偏旋律化，在混音里较宽。Grohl 的底鼓常像硬切一样标出段落。

后来的乐队常只沿用强弱外形。公开拒绝摇滚明星扮相则较难当作方法复制。

body.en:
Short circulated interview lines record public argument with fame. They sit beside high stage volume as period evidence.

Read them against Nevermind and In Utero: the tension between hit singles and anti-idol talk is part of the historical record.
body.zh:
流传的访谈短句记录了当众与成名争辩的说法。它们与高音量现场并置，作为同期证据。

对照《Nevermind》与《In Utero》阅读：热单与反偶像言论之间的张力是史料的一部分。

body.en:
Britpop often answered with brighter chords and clearer pop structures. Indie scenes kept smaller DIY scales. Radiohead moved toward studio experimentation rather than flannel-era costume.

Nirvana remain a fixed early-90s reference for quiet-loud writing on rock radio.
body.zh:
Britpop 常用更亮的和弦与更清晰的流行结构回应。Indie 场景维持较小的 DIY 尺度。Radiohead 更多走向录音室实验，而非法兰绒时期的外观。

Nirvana 仍是 90 年代初摇滚电台强弱写法的固定参照。

note.en:
Bleach-era lineup before Grohl joined.

Bleach drummers are Burckhard, Foster, Crover, and Channing. Everman is the 1989 guitar credit. Peters (Mudhoney) plays before Grohl joins.
note.zh:
Grohl 加入前的 Bleach 时期阵容。

《Bleach》时期鼓手是 Burckhard、Foster、Crover 与 Channing。Everman 是 1989 年的吉他署名。Peters（Mudhoney）在 Grohl 加入前打过鼓。

note.en: Nevermind / In Utero trio; Grohl later forms Foo Fighters.
note.zh: 《Nevermind》《In Utero》三人组；Grohl 后来组建 Foo Fighters。

note.en: Quiet-loud single that fixed Nevermind on global rock radio.
note.zh: 强弱动态单曲；固定《Nevermind》在全球摇滚电台的位置。

note.en: Sub Pop origins and MTV-scale reach within one album cycle (Nevermind).
note.zh: Sub Pop 起点与 MTV 尺度到达，集中在同一张专辑周期（《Nevermind》）。
